additional_info.subject: ID0440106-DC/Si-D/SA- [MP/ N8 160368830] Charging issue CRM:02684000440
additional_info.body:
Dear Raed, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
I have merged all 4 cases ID0440103, ID0440104, ID0440105 and ID0440106 in one ticket since it all relates to the same issue.
After a thorough investigation, I would like to clarify several important points regarding the charging process and vehicle interaction:
System Architecture and Control:
The vehicle's onboard systems, not the charging station, maintain complete control over the auxiliary battery management
The charging station does not have direct control over the vehicle's power management systems
Technical Verification:
Our charging stations are designed to disengage completely from active communication once a charging session is properly terminated. The station cannot independently "wake up" the vehicle or force it to maintain an active state.
Given these technical facts, we can confirm that the charging station is not the root cause of the 12V battery discharge. The management of the auxiliary battery's charge state falls under the vehicle's internal power management system.
Can you please tell me if you are facing this issue with one particular brand of car?
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco

Please be informed that we have identified a 12V battery drop issue during charging with the following vehicle models:
GV70
GV60
Ioniq 5
Chevrolet Bolt
Tesla Model 3
Tesla Model Y
We would appreciate your support in addressing this matter.
Best regards,

additional_info.subject: ID0440106-DC/Si-D/SA- [MP/ N8 160368830] Charging issue CRM:02684000440
additional_info.body:
Dear Raed,
Please be aware that 3 out of 4 stations are in a very dated firmware version. The latest version is v7.0.5.
170000002 - v4.0.11 - charger is offline
170002951 - v3.0.2
160368830 - v4.0.11 - charger is offline
170002950 -
v7.0.5
To analyse properly the situations for the first 3 chargers, we need them online and on the latest FW version.
If you have a date where this problem occurred for charger
170002950
please give me a time and date and I can provide you an answer shortly.
I look forward for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
